news.title: McKenna tops 15 minutes in NHL debut as Maple Leafs fall
news.ruTitle: Маккенна превзошел 15-минутный результат в дебютном матче НХЛ после падения "Мэйпл Лифс"
news.description: No. 1 overall pick Gavin McKenna, 18, made his NHL debut Tuesday night, when the Toronto Maple Leafs fell to the Montreal Canadiens, 3-2, in the season opener, and he told reporters after the loss that "to get that first one under my belt, it feels good."

news.title: Eichel hits 700 points as Golden Knights beat Blackhawks in Ryan Craig’s first game behind the bench
news.ruTitle: Эйхель набирает 700 очков, когда «Голден Найтс» обыграли «Блэкхокс» в первой игре Райана Крейга за скамейкой запасных
news.description: — Jack Eichel had a goal and two assists to reach 701 career points, and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 in their season opener Tuesday night.

news.title: Paul Cotter scores in OT as the Canucks beat the Oilers 6-5 in the opener
news.ruTitle: Пол Коттер забивает в овертайме, когда «Кэнакс» обыграли «Ойлерз» со счетом 6–5 в первом матче
news.description: — Paul Cotter scored 1:59 into overtime to cap a two-goal game as the Vancouver Canucks got the season off to a strong start with a 6-5 win over the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday night.

news.title: Fraser Minten shines as late surge lifts the Bruins past the Rangers 3-0
news.ruTitle: Фрейзер Минтен блистает: в конце матча "Брюинз" обыграли "Рейнджерс" со счетом 3:0.
news.description: — Fraser Minten broke a scoreless tie with just over four minutes left, followed by goals by JJ Peterka and an empty-netter by Mark Kastelic 23 seconds apart, and the Boston Bruins beat the New York Rangers 3-0 on Tuesday night in the season opener...

news.title: Carrier's goal late in the 3rd period helps Canadiens beat Maple Leafs 3-2
news.ruTitle: Гол Кэрриера в конце третьего периода помог «Канадиенс» обыграть «Мэйпл Лифс» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Josh Anderson and Alexandre Carrier each had a goal and assist as the Montreal Canadiens beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2 Tuesday night in the teams' season opener.

news.title: Where to watch the 2026-27 NHL opening day lineup
news.ruTitle: Где посмотреть состав на день открытия НХЛ сезона 2026/27?
news.description: The defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes raise their championship banner before taking on the Florida Panthers in the season-opening matchup.

news.title: Best fits from NHL opening night arrivals
news.ruTitle: Лучшие моменты из прибытий на премьеру НХЛ
news.description: Players rocked some fierce looks before the first games of the NHL's 2026-27 season.

news.title: Panthers win in overtime, spoil Hurricanes' banner night
news.ruTitle: «Пантерс» выиграли в овертайме и испортили знаменательный вечер «Харрикейнз»
news.description: On a night when the NHL's last three title winners were on display, Gustav Forsling fired a shot past Brandon Bussi with 4.3 seconds left in OT, lifting the Florida Panthers past the Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes 1-0 in Tuesday's season opener.

news.title: Forsling's OT blast lifts Panthers past reigning Stanley Cup champion Hurricanes 1-0
news.ruTitle: Удар Форслинга в овертайме позволил "Пантерам" обойти действующего чемпиона Кубка Стэнли "Харрикейнз" со счетом 1:0.
news.description: — Gustav Forsling hammered a shot past Brandon Bussi with 4.3 seconds left in overtime to lift the Florida Panthers past the reigning Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes 1-0 in Tuesday's season opener for both teams.

news.title: Matthew Mayich's parents want ASU coaches to be put on leave
news.ruTitle: Родители Мэтью Майича требуют, чтобы тренеров АСУ отправили в отпуск
news.description: The parents of Matthew Mayich, the Arizona State hockey player who collapsed during an outdoor workout last month, are calling for the coaches involved to be removed until an independent investigation is completed.

news.title: Wild top-pair D-man Brock Faber has surgery on fractured skull
news.ruTitle: Игроку дикой топ-пары Броку Фаберу сделали операцию по поводу перелома черепа
news.description: Wild top-pair defenseman Brock Faber underwent surgery for a fractured skull and is out indefinitely.
